summary: Enhance your skills with our IT Outsourcing and Vendor Management Training Course. Learn effective strategies to optimize vendor relationships and drive success
lede: IT outsourcing management training helps IT vendor, sourcing, and contract managers govern external technology providers. It covers evaluating providers, defining measurable service levels and contract obligations, and tracking supplier performance through KPIs and scorecards. Learners also practice supplier risk assessment, accountability mapping, escalation and transition planning, and exit preparation across single- and multi-provider arrangements.
audienceIntro: This IT outsourcing course suits professionals who manage external technology providers, supplier obligations, service performance, transition activity, or technology risk. It supports experienced practitioners who need a consistent governance approach across single-provider and multi-provider environments.
modules: Vendor Performance Strategy and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet capability and access to a browser. The course uses provided, anonymized supplier data and templates. You do not need to install ServiceNow, Jira, or Power BI before the course. Power BI activities remain at operational dashboard-design level, and advanced analytics or production system configuration sits outside the course scope.
